efi-upper-intake.summary: Distinguish the casting exterior from the air passage

steps.title: Follow the six runners
steps.text: Six curved runners connect the compact upper chamber to the longer lower flange. Their broad exterior faces and rounded edges follow visible Ford, owner and specimen comparisons.

steps.title: Inspect the protected air path
steps.text: The added exterior faces leave the existing circular passages and mounting interfaces unchanged. Those passage sections remain project estimates; photographs do not measure their hidden shape.

steps.title: Recognize the evidence limit
steps.text: A later F5TE-marked specimen helps explain the broad casting form, but it does not establish the exact casting on this1994 truck. Widths, depths, radii and wall distribution remain inferred.

troubleshooting.title: Separate appearance from clearance
troubleshooting.text: A broad face may look closer to the reference yet obstruct a neighboring part. The model checks added material against nearby parts and sampled rocker, throttle and cable positions; it does not claim measured factory tolerances.

efi-upper-intake.limits: Source-compared exterior only. No new PCV receiver, support-bracket lower anchor or production casting dimensions are established.
